newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth wireless, extra features up Q3 EPS.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth wireless, extra features up Q3 EPS.

text.p: BellSouth Corp said on Thursday that growth in access lines, wireless operations and a jump in revenue from enhanced calling features has helped it post record third quarter earnings of $0.63 per share.

Quarterly revenues from features such as Caller ID, Call Waiting and other enhanced services rose 43 percent to about $281 million, the company said. Caller ID features in service jumped 96.5 percent during the past 12 months to more than 3 million, the company said.

BellSouth said its domestic wireless operations reached 3.3 million customers at the end of the quarter, representing an annual rate of 31 percent. In its 11 international cellular markets, BellSouth said its customers more than doubled since September 1995, passing the one-million-customer milestone in July.

BellSouth said it added a total of 222,000 access lines during July, August and September, representing a 4.9 percent annual growth rate and a third-quarter record. Business access lines grew 8.5 percent, the company said.
